name: Cool Payment Gateway with Viumi for WooCommerce
author: Matías Anca

sections.description:
Cool Payment Gateway with Viumi for WooCommerce

External services

This plugin uses the Viumi API service to process payments.
Viumi is a payment gateway provider that allows you to process payments in Argentina.
This plugin sends the customer checkout data from WooCommerce to Viumi API to process the payment in order to get the payment link.
Viumi Site Url: https://www.viumi.com.ar
Viumi Terms of Service: https://www.viumi.com.ar/terminos-y-condiciones.html
Viumi Privacy Policy: https://www.viumi.com.ar/politica-de-privacidad.html
Viumi Documentation: https://developers.viumi.com.ar/page/checkout/requirements
Viumi Dashboard: https://dashboard.viumi.com.ar
Viumi Checkout API Services: https://api-macro.preprod.geopagos.com, https://api.viumi.com.ar
Viumi Auth API Services: https://auth.preprod.geopagos.com, https://auth.geopagos.com
